# Flooring WebPros

> Flooring WebPros builds fast, mobile-first websites and runs local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI search
> optimization only for flooring businesses in the United States: hardwood, carpet, tile and stone, LVP and laminate,
> epoxy, refinishing, showrooms and commercial flooring. Monthly plans from 60 USD, no build fee, no long-term
> contract, and a free homepage mockup before you pay.

## Plans
- Launch: 60 USD/month. Establish your online presence: professional website design and development, website hosting and maintenance, a 90+ Google PageSpeed score on desktop and mobile, and an online estimate request form.
- Build: 80 USD/month. Everything in Launch, plus Google Business Profile setup and management, local SEO optimization, AI search visibility optimization and an AI-enabled chat feature on your website.
- Scale: 120 USD/month. Everything in Build, plus Facebook and Instagram setup and maintenance, 4-6 social media posts per month and 4 Google Business Profile posts per month.
